headline: Brown & Brown (NYSE:BRO) Misses Q2 CY2026 Revenue Estimates
summary: Insurance brokerage firm Brown & Brown (NYSE:BRO) missed Wall Street’s revenue expectations in Q2 CY2026, but sales rose 30.4% year on year to $1.68 billion. Its non-GAAP profit of $1.07 per share was in line with analysts’ consensus estimates.
